posts.text: I wake up, feel the spark, and move

ADHD was never about a lack of attention. You can hyperfocus on a video about octopuses for three hours and still forget to eat. That's not a deficit, that's an interest-based attention system, it gives full access when something is engaging, urgent, or new, and almost none when it's boring, even if boring means important. The frustrating part is the world runs on reminders and importance, not interest.
ADHD taught me that consistency looks different for everyone. Be honest — this one’s you too, right?
ADHD hack has 100 ideas before breakfast so I learned to design around my brain.
My ADHD brain: “Let’s fix our life.” Also my ADHD brain: spends 4 hours organizing icons on the desktop.
I can’t handle boring systems. That’s why I built my own.
